blocks.content: Before saving anything, you need to understand the current state of your project. Run:

On branch main

No commits yet

Untracked files:
  index.html
  style.css

nothing added to commit but untracked files present
"Untracked" means Git can see the files, but is not saving them yet.

blocks.alt: Terminal showing git status with untracked files listed

blocks.content: You will use git status often. It is the fastest way to understand what is happening in your project.
